description: This file contains implementation code for container management within the WPEFramework, including classes and methods for container lifecycle operations such as creation, starting, stopping, and status checks, as well as singleton access patterns and logging initialization.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Class responsible for managing container instances, including creation and logging.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Class representing a container instance with methods to start, stop, and query container status.

methods.name: IContainerAdministrator::Instance
methods.description: Provides singleton access to the container administrator instance.

methods.name: CRunContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on search paths and configuration.

methods.name: CRunContainer::CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing container with configuration and logging setup.

methods.name: CRunContainer::~CRunContainer
methods.description: Destructor that stops the container if running and removes it from the administrator.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information of the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container.

methods.name: CRunContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: CRunContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: CRunContainer::OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces the container's process arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: CRunContainer::ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Removes leftover containers that may exist from previous runs.
